invalid_run_rule.note: If native-dpdk median @64B < 600,000 the deployment is bad (not a regression): mark the run INVALID and exit 2 (infra), do not report a gate FAIL.

tokio-dpdk.note: Headline tokio-vs-rust gate. The 700k step is judged ONLY here (not per-step).

rust-dpdk.note: Deployment-normalized sync no-regression gate: same-run native-dpdk is the denominator. 1400B is report-only (rust is 81-87% of native when TRex is not line-rate capped). The vs-0.3.0 absolute comparison is report-only (report_only_metrics.vs_0_3_0).

tokio-dpdk-concurrent.note: Floor at 64B only. enabled=false means report-only; the PR that drops the tokio outer mutex flips it to true.

per_step_tokio_vs_rust.note: tokio-dpdk (fair) rx_pps >= 98% of the same-run rust-dpdk rx_pps at 70k/140k/350k (rep 1 only, a single sample). 700k is excluded.

idle_cpu.note: Judged only when the 0-pps step ran; enabled by the PR that adds that step.

dut_latency.note: DUT p50/p99 are reported, never gated.

vs_0_3_0.note: Report-only 'vs 0.3.0' comparison with a WARN marker below 98%. It never gates.
